_doc: Şuşa (0.20.1, a short Qarabağ map): a 1.5 km two-lane loop on the Şuşa plateau. The north straight (start, the mosque, the ŞUŞA sign), the west bend, the south leg dipping to the rim of the Daşaltı gorge beside the fortress wall (Vaqif's mausoleum), back up the east bend. control: [x, y, z, full_width, theme 4 = forest]. Terrain: tools/blender/karabakh_terrain.py --track karabakh_shusha (the 'terrain' block: inner / ring extents, plateau, gorge). Landmarks: tools/karabakh_maps_layout.py.
